script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

Title: A Small Town's Big Surprise

FADE IN:

INT. COUNTY FAIRGROUNDS - DAY

A quaint, small-town county fair is in full swing. CARNIVAL MUSIC plays in the background. VENDORS hawk their wares, CROWDS cheer, and FERRIS WHEEL RIDERS enjoy the view.

Scene 1 - EXCITED ANNOUNCER

A plump, enthusiastic ANNOUNCER stands on stage. He wears a microphone and a red and white striped vest.

ANNOUNCER
(into microphone)
Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, gather 'round! We have a surprise for this year's fair that will change our little town forever!

Scene 2 - MYSTERIOUS STRANGER

In the crowd, a MYSTERIOUS STRANGER, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and sunglasses, looks intrigued.

Scene 3 - EXCITED ANNOUNCER (CONT'D)

ANNOUNCER
(into microphone)
Our very own local inventor, MRS. WATSON, has created something truly extraordinary! Come one, come all, and witness the incredible, the unbelievable, the... WHAT'S THAT?

Scene 4 - MRS. WATSON'S APPROACH

Mrs. Watson, a kindly, bespectacled woman in a flowered apron and gingham dress, enters, followed by her clumsy assistant, LUCY.

Scene 5 - SCEPTICAL CROWD

The CROWD murmurs as the ANNOUNCER introduces Mrs. Watson.

Scene 6 - MR. JOHNSON'S APPROACH

MR. JOHNSON, a skeptical fair organizer, approaches Mrs. Watson.

MR. JOHNSON
Mrs. Watson, you know I can't allow any... absurdities on my fairgrounds.

Scene 7 - MRS. WATSON'S ASSURANCE

Mrs. Watson smiles and reassures Mr. Johnson that her invention is harmless and will bring joy to everyone.

Scene 8 - MRS. WATSON'S DEMONSTRATION

Mrs. Watson sets up her invention: a large, wooden box with a crank on the side and several levers. She asks the MYSTERIOUS STRANGER to help demonstrate it.

Scene 9 - MYSTERIOUS STRANGER'S RELUCTANCE

The MYSTERIOUS STRANGER hesitates, but eventually agrees.

Scene 10 - SUCCESSFUL DEMONSTRATION

As the MYSTERIOUS STRANGER turns the crank, the box emits a series of beautiful, enchanting melodies. The crowd is astounded and delighted.

Scene 11 - MR. JOHNSON'S AMAZED REACTION

Mr. Johnson watches, his skepticism replaced with wonder and awe.

Scene 12 - ANNOUNCER'S ENCOURAGEMENT

The ANNOUNCER urges Mrs. Watson to set up her invention for the entire fair to enjoy.

Scene 13 - MRS. WATSON'S APPRECIATION

Mrs. Watson thanks the MYSTERIOUS STRANGER for his help and expresses her gratitude to everyone for their support.

Scene 14 - FAIRGOERS' DELIGHT

FAIRGOERS gather around the invention, smiling, laughing, and playing various levers to create their own melodies.

Scene 15 - MYSTERIOUS STRANGER'S REVEAL

As the day wears on, the MYSTERIOUS STRANGER reveals that he is actually a traveling musician who was charmed by Mrs. Watson's invention and the town's charm. He offers to perform a concert for the fair, which is met with great excitement.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
